paragraphs.text: Ronald is a human farmer from Eldraine , and the stepfather of Kellan .

Ronald is a steadfast and compassionate husband of Alyse and stepfather of Kellan , who embodies the qualities of a supportive protector. His deep empathy and unwavering commitment to his family make him an important figure in Kellan's life. Ronald’s presence is marked by gentle strength and quiet determination, providing both comfort and guidance to Kellan. His ability to remain calm and reassuring, even in the face of Kellan’s troubles, underscores his role as a stabilizing force within their home. When Kellan returns from his first quest, Ronald’s joy is palpable, reflecting his caring and practical nature. His attentiveness extends to practical matters as well, showing his thoughtfulness and dedication to creating a nurturing environment. Ronald's actions and demeanor highlight his supportive role and his commitment to fostering a safe and loving home.

Ronald played a crucial role in supporting his stepson, Kellan , during a difficult time. When Kellan returned home with injuries from a confrontation with local bullies, Ronald quickly responded by fetching water and assisting his wife in caring for Kellan’s wounds. Despite the boy's reluctance to discuss the cause of his injuries, Ronald remained attentive and concerned. He noticed the peculiar nature of the injuries — evidence of cold iron and yew — and questioned Kellan about the incident. Ronald’s calm demeanor and reassuring words helped alleviate Kellan’s fears about his identity and the potential truth of the taunts he had received. By emphasizing that Kellan’s worth was determined by who he was, not where he came from, Ronald provided the emotional support necessary for Kellan to feel valued and loved, reinforcing his role as a protective and affirming figure in his stepson’s life.

When Kellan returned from his quest, Ronald eagerly dropped his axe upon spotting his stepson and ran to embrace him. He was overjoyed by Kellan’s return and shouted to his wife about their son's arrival. After warmly greeting Kellan, Ronald assisted in making their reunion special. He then went out to get some tea from the Browns to ensure a comfortable and welcoming home for Kellan to stay at, however briefly.
